title: skills: a runner that executes the catalog's eval cases with a no-skill arm, plus trigger evals; weekly and on the touched skill
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「三点都同意，按最终计划把后续里程碑的卡全部立出来」, and, on the list of thirteen cards the seat then showed: 「同意」. The ruling records are #34659 comment 6940528935 and #34691 comment 6943107981. Readings: objectstack `a0326b06`, cloud `53a5844`, 2026-11-17.

## Why

The catalog ships eval cases with printed answers and nobody sits the exam. A skill that teaches something wrong, or that is never loaded, ships anyway and is found in a customer's app.

Who acts: the devx lane (`packages/qa/**`, the eval files under `skills/*/evals/`). Reader: the eval seat each week, and any seat changing a skill.

## Evidence

- `skills/*/evals/*.json`: 208 cases in 26 files. No runner in the repository; the only mechanical use is `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`, which checks each `must_contain` token against the skill's own Markdown.
- This seat ran all 208 cases once per arm through `claude -p` on a subscription login, with and without the skill in `.claude/skills/`: 416 runs in 66 minutes, no API spend. No case passed only without the skill. Scores are with the maintainer.
- In the with-skill arm the Skill tool was invoked in a minority of runs; the model often reached the text by reading files instead.
- Of 15 failing transcripts read: 5 model error, 4 skill present but not loaded or read, 4 over-literal assertion, 2 prompt needs a project on disk, 0 skill does not teach it.
- Over-literal examples: `objectstack-automation/flows-triggers-approvals#13` requires the token `hotcrm.custom`; `objectstack-i18n/bundles-locales-coverage#10` forbids `verdict: {`, which a correct answer quotes as the wrong shape.
- 35 of 416 runs hit a 10-turn limit, mostly hunting for a repository that was not there.
- Supabase, Convex and Directus each run their skill evals with a no-skill arm and grade end state, not tokens.

## Scope

- A runner that takes a skill, places it in a scratch project, runs each case with and without it, and grades mechanically. One command per skill; results recorded per case.
- The cases' assertions are reviewed once: an over-literal token is replaced by a check of what the answer does.
- About 40 trigger cases across the metadata skills, at least one in ten negative, graded on whether the skill was loaded.
- A weekly round is the eval seat's; the touched skill's cases run when a skills PR changes it. The runner reports; it does not block a merge.
- File surface: `packages/qa/**`, `skills/*/evals/**`.

## Done when

- One round over all cases is on record with both arms.
- The description rewrite (sibling card) is accepted on this runner's trigger cases, before and after.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Decision record: #34691 S2 = A. Related: #34687 (the ask-mode option in the scenario runner).
- Dedup, open and closed: `scenario runner ask skills directory flag` 1 unrelated hit (#9417, a QA run record).
